_note: Open-source voice AI frameworks and how each reaches the phone network through VoiceTel, reviewed by reading each repository's source at reviewedCommit. Not tested on live calls. Re-review when a framework's telephony code or VoiceML's Media Streams support changes, and update `reviewed`.

frameworks.name: Pipecat
frameworks.configure: Use Pipecat's Twilio serializer and set its base_url to https://voiceml.voicetel.com so automatic hang-up goes to VoiceML.

frameworks.name: LiveKit Agents
frameworks.connects: VoiceTel SIP trunking to LiveKit SIP
frameworks.configure: Create LiveKit inbound and outbound SIP trunks for your VoiceTel numbers. Its Twilio-specific transfer helper calls Twilio's API directly and doesn't apply.

frameworks.name: Dograh
frameworks.connects: Its Asterisk ARI provider, with Asterisk on a VoiceTel SIP trunk
frameworks.configure: Its Twilio provider is fixed to Twilio's API host for number setup, outbound calls, and transfers, so use the Asterisk provider or change that host.

frameworks.name: TEN Framework
frameworks.connects: VoiceML <Connect><Stream>, with its Twilio voice-assistant example
frameworks.configure: The example places and ends calls with the Twilio Python SDK; point the SDK at VoiceML with a custom HTTP client.

frameworks.name: Bolna
frameworks.connects: VoiceML <Connect><Stream> (Twilio provider), or Asterisk on a VoiceTel SIP trunk (sip-trunk provider)
frameworks.configure: Inbound calls use its <Connect><Stream> response as-is; for outbound calls through its Twilio API server, point the Twilio Python SDK at VoiceML.
